a96676e5-8ae2-425e-b549-7f15dd34a6d8.title: Komi-san wa Komyushou Desu.
a96676e5-8ae2-425e-b549-7f15dd34a6d8.altTitle: Miss Komi Is Bad at Communication.
a96676e5-8ae2-425e-b549-7f15dd34a6d8.description:
Komi-san is a beautiful and admirable girl that no one can take their eyes off of. Almost the whole school sees her as the cold beauty that's out of their league, but Tadano Hitohito knows the truth: she's just really bad at communicating with others.

Komi-san, who wishes to fix this bad habit of hers, tries to improve it with the help of Tadano-kun by achieving her goal of having 100 friends.

e0589f47-72f9-4e9a-ac31-5b88bcad6220.title: Chiyu Mahou no Machigatta Tsukaikata ~Senjou wo Kakeru Kaifuku Youin~
e0589f47-72f9-4e9a-ac31-5b88bcad6220.altTitle: The Wrong Way to Use Healing Magic
e0589f47-72f9-4e9a-ac31-5b88bcad6220.description: Usato, an ordinary high schooler, happens to run into two fellow students after school one rainy day. Suddenly, all three of them are engulfed in a magic circle and transported to a fantasy world. There's just one tiny problem — Usato is simply dragged along by accident!  On top of that, Usato learns that he is capable of using healing magic — an incredibly rare affinity in this new world. Now Usato must spend his days with the rescue team thugs, struggling through their hellish training regimen — learning the wrong way to use healing magic.

4028472c-5ee4-4e5a-9d61-6aea6449edd9.title: Boyish Kanojo ga Kawaisugiru
4028472c-5ee4-4e5a-9d61-6aea6449edd9.altTitle: My Boyish Girlfriend is Too Cute.
4028472c-5ee4-4e5a-9d61-6aea6449edd9.description:
Akira is boyish in both looks and personality—and Daichi, her childhood friend turned boyfriend by their first year of high school, thinks she's too cute. Girly outfits aren't her thing... so why does he suddenly find her in a cat-eared maid costume at the school festival!?

*Source: Manga UP! Global*
___
**Note:** Originally published as 他校のボーイッシュ彼女 (Takou no Boyish Kanojo) as a web manga released on the author's Twitter account since September 4, 2024 and published as ボーイッシュ彼女が可愛すぎる (Boyish Kanojo ga Kawaisugiru) in print by Square Enix since March 22, 2025.

024af7a5-f8ad-4b67-b950-b1708f52b018.altTitle: There Was a Cute Girl in the Hero's Party, so I Tried Confessing to Her
024af7a5-f8ad-4b67-b950-b1708f52b018.description: Youki was reincarnated in another world. However, instead of being reincarnated as the hero or the demon lord, he was instead reincarnated half-assedly as a minion of the Demon Lord. One day, the Hero's Party attacked the Demon Lord's castle with the intent of defeating the Demon Lord. Of course, Youki was able to repel their attempt with ease. In spite of this, he ended up falling for the cleric, Cecilia, at first sight...

04c892b3-a202-46f5-ad11-0d433e712ab8.altTitle: Dealing with Mikadono Sisters is a Breeze
04c892b3-a202-46f5-ad11-0d433e712ab8.description: Meskipun Ayase Yuu adalah putra seorang aktris terkenal dan berbakat, dia berada di bawah rata-rata dalam segala hal yang dia lakukan. Dia dipercaya untuk hidup di bawah asuhan teman ibunya, dan kemudian mengetahui bahwa dia juga akan sekamar dengan tiga saudara perempuan dari sekolahnya yang memiliki kecantikan dan bakat. Meskipun Yuu berpikir bahwa pemahaman tidak mungkin dicapai antara orang biasa dan mereka yang diberkati dengan bakat, ketiga saudara perempuan itu secara mengejutkan...?!

f0aa2ca6-8985-4b6f-beda-f7fa1956422e.title: Saijaku Tamer wa Gomi Hiroi no Tabi wo Hajimemashita
f0aa2ca6-8985-4b6f-beda-f7fa1956422e.altTitle: The Weakest Tamer Began a Journey to Pick up Trash
f0aa2ca6-8985-4b6f-beda-f7fa1956422e.description:
**A heartwarming fantasy isekai tale about a girl who embarks on a journey with her new friend–a humble slime.**

When Ivy learns she’s “starless,” she knows her life is over. Without stars, she can’t use her Tamer skill to subdue even the smallest of animals. So she flees into the forest, where she befriends a lowly slime named Sora—the one creature she can tame. Together, this unlikely pair begins salvaging other people’s rubbish in an attempt to turn their lives around!

*Source: Seven Seas Entertainment, Vol. 1*

- [Original Web Novel](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n9629ex/)

0c0c9937-99f2-434a-bf0d-1ccbd41f5ba8.title: Goinmul Healer ga Neomu Ganghada
0c0c9937-99f2-434a-bf0d-1ccbd41f5ba8.altTitle: The Late Game Healer Is Way Too Strong
0c0c9937-99f2-434a-bf0d-1ccbd41f5ba8.description: Top Korean hunter Siu 'The Rabid Hound' Min defeated the Demon Lord with his disciples, only to be trapped in a monster-filled otherworld for 100 years. However, a century of struggles did not break Siu—it drove him to break his limits instead. Now, he returns to Earth with Pred, his mysterious partner, only to learn that his name and legacy have been erased, along with his disciples’... and that only 10 years have passed on Earth. As new conflicts arise, will Siu and Pred prevail and uncover the truth?

5b2c7a03-ca53-43f0-abc8-031c0c136ae6.title: Wonder Cat Kyuu-chan
5b2c7a03-ca53-43f0-abc8-031c0c136ae6.description:
There’s more to this kitty than meets the eye! Kyuu-chan loves snacks, cuddles, and bow ties, but most of all loves Hinata, the young professional who adopted this mischievous wonder cat into his home.

As the two adjust to life together, they discover that they have a lot to learn from each other.

The ordinary and the extraordinary live side by side in this delightful slice-of-life manga!

53c277e3-8aa3-4fc6-8d0a-cb02d30b606d.title: Ruri no Houseki
53c277e3-8aa3-4fc6-8d0a-cb02d30b606d.description:
Mineral collecting is a modern-day treasure hunt!

Ruri, a high school girl who loves jewelry and accessories, ventures into the world of mineral collecting in mountains, rivers, and caves. The first volume features numerous minerals, including quartz, garnet, pyrite, gold sand, and fluorite. The collection scenes are full of fascinating scenes using specialized tools such as a panning dish, hammer, and topographical maps. This is an authentic science adventure based on the solid knowledge of the author, who is trained in mineralogy!

ff745f77-5609-40c9-b856-ace2501a6764.title: The Delivery Man From Murim
ff745f77-5609-40c9-b856-ace2501a6764.description: Stranded in a new world, Smiley Kang covertly lives the life of a delivery man. Until now, humanity has fended off demonic beasts and their portal “gates.” There are the Awakened, citizens imbued with supernatural abilities, and there are those more scheming, fighting to monopolize and claim demonic resources. But as the number of gates starts to rise, the world is at risk once again. Can humanity survive another onslaught of demonic beasts? The answer lies with the mysterious delivery man…

706a3219-646d-4fdd-833c-234ca616029e.title: Tedama ni Toritai Kurokiya-san
706a3219-646d-4fdd-833c-234ca616029e.altTitle: Kurokiya-San Wants to Lead Him Around by the Nose
706a3219-646d-4fdd-833c-234ca616029e.description:
Kurokiya Ruu is on the verge of repeating a year, and in an attempt to fix her grades, her teachers get a top student to tutor her: Tadashi Tadao (name literally translates to *straight-forward man*), who happens to be her childhood friend who she hasn't seen since they went to different middle schools.

However, they end up not getting any studying done as she uses this situation to try and seduce him at every turn.   
  
This is the story of a girl who wants to get her crush flustered and lead him around by his nose, and a straight-forward guy who won't get embarrassed.

133ec785-0677-4e22-8186-e15ed0621c36.description: Shindo Manabu is a student at a very prestigious high school whose goal is to get into Tokyo University. He studies constantly and tries to never lose sight of that goal. That is until his childhood friend, Amano Megumi, who goes to the same school starts to distract him. He originally only remembered her as the tomboy she was as a kid, until he notices how "developed" she has become. As these two get closer to each other, hilarity often ensues and subsequently, Manabu becomes more and more distracted from his goal of getting into Tokyo U.

7d425c5c-2bc0-4f50-b3e5-eebb0e222cf0.title: Osananajimi wa Sasoeba Itsu demo Dekiru Kankei
7d425c5c-2bc0-4f50-b3e5-eebb0e222cf0.altTitle: My Childhood Friend Is Always Down Whenever I Make a Move
7d425c5c-2bc0-4f50-b3e5-eebb0e222cf0.description:
“Should we continue what we started back then… at Shunta's house?”

Arima Shunta, a childhood friend of Watase Maria. She is a beautiful girl who is immensely popular with the boys, and Arima Shunta is a geeky high school freshman. The two are childhood friends who have played together every day for as long as they can remember.

Though they had grown distant due to an “incident” back in their second year of middle school, they find themselves sitting next to each other after a seat reshuffle in high school.

One day, Maria suddenly asks him, “If you want to see my breasts, should I show them to you?”.

After school, in Shunta's room, Maria says, “I'll only show my body to you, Shunta.”, and begins to take off her uniform, revealing her developed chest right in front of him…

A naughty youth romcom featuring a childhood friend who has grown a seductive body.
___
**Character Designer:** [Unasaka](https://mangadex.org/author/c8ca0e89-12c5-4765-bd99-58a2fea1d89b)
